M=[i for i,n in enumerate(s) if n.startswith('ma_') and n.endswith('_5_21')]

t=sum(abs(v) for v in w.values()); w={k:v/t for k,v in w.items()}
json.dump(w,open('w.json','w'))
print(bt.backtest(w))
